description: A standard sealed container of the prisoner's property.
Property the prisoner is not allowed to keep in possession, held in storage.
Valuables, held separately from the prisoner's other property.
Property taken from the prisoner and held rather than returned.
The container was created and sealed. Carries the initial seal number.
The container was resealed. Carries the new seal number; the container id does not change.
The container's type was changed.
The container was moved to another storage location - internal, or offsite to Branston.
The owner was received at another establishment, so the property is due to follow them.
The owner was released, so the property is due to be returned to them.
The owner died in custody, so the property is due to be returned.
The container was transferred out to another prison. This removes it from the sending prison; the receiving prison holds a separate record, reconciled via related_container_id.
The container was returned to the prisoner.
Disposal was recorded as required. Note the DISPOSAL_REQUIRED status is derived by comparing proposed_disposal_date with today, not from this event.
The container was disposed of (destroyed).
The container was combined into a new sealed container.
The container was recorded in error.
Removed from the establishment with no recorded reason - what a NOMIS inactive container maps to, where it cannot be told whether it was returned, disposed or transferred.
A removed container was brought back into active storage, reversing a REMOVED.
In active storage.
Still held here, but the owner has moved, so it is due to follow them.
Due to be returned, because the owner has been released or died in custody.
The proposed disposal date has arrived and the container is still held. Derived from proposed_disposal_date at read time, so it is not stored in current_status.
Disposed of (destroyed), and out of active storage.
Returned to the prisoner, and out of active storage.
Transferred out to another prison. Never shown for a live container - the sending prison's record is removed with outcome TRANSFERRED.
Combined into another container, and out of active storage.
Recorded in error, and out of active storage.
Removed with no recorded reason. Reversible - a REACTIVATED event returns it to STORED.
Left active storage because it was disposed of.
Left active storage because it was returned to the prisoner.
Left active storage because it was transferred to another prison.
Left active storage because it was combined into another container.
Left active storage because it was recorded in error.
Left active storage for no recorded reason. The only reversible outcome.
A storage location within the prison. The location id is a hmpps-locations-inside-prison-api location UUID.
The offsite Branston warehouse, which has no internal location id.
